verdict.rationale: Both PRs make the same one-line fix in `parse_entries`, skipping blank or whitespace-only lines while keeping line numbering. A also updates the README sentence that said any unreadable line stops the import, so the docs match the new behavior. B leaves that sentence stale, although its report points out the behavior choice. A's tests are a little broader, checking blank lines both mid-file and at the end in the parsed result.
a_issues: Report spends space on a failed first attempt that left nothing behind, which is noise even if it is honest
b_issues: README still says a line that cannot be read stops the import, which no longer holds for blank lines
Trailing-line test covers only a bare `\n` and does not check the parsed result of a whitespace-only line
